description: This file is a Java unit test for the ImmutableSearchQueryBuilder class in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.thingsearch package, testing various aspects of search query building and validation.

classes.name: ImmutableSearchQueryBuilderTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ImmutableSearchQueryBuilder, testing various query configurations and validation scenarios.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullSearchFilter
methods.description: Tests that creating an ImmutableSearchQueryBuilder with a null search filter throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToSetSortAscWithNullJsonPointer
methods.description: Tests that setting sort ascending with a null JsonPointer throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToSetSortAscWithNullString
methods.description: Tests that setting sort ascending with a null string throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToSetSortDescWithNullJsonPointer
methods.description: Tests that setting sort descending with a null JsonPointer throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToSetSortDescWithNullString
methods.description: Tests that setting sort descending with a null string throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: removeSortOptionWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that removing a sort option by property path works as intended.

methods.name: overwritingSortOptionWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that overwriting sort options functions correctly.

methods.name: buildQueryWithoutSortOption
methods.description: Checks that building a query without sort options results in no sort.

methods.name: buildQueryWithSortOption
methods.description: Verifies that building a query with sort options produces expected sorting string.

methods.name: tryToSetLimitOptionWithNegativeOffset
methods.description: Ensures that setting a negative offset throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: tryToSetLimitOptionWithNegativeCount
methods.description: Ensures that setting a negative count throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: tryToSetLimitOptionWithTooBigCount
methods.description: Ensures that setting a count greater than max throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: removeLimitOptionWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that removing limit options functions as intended.

methods.name: buildQueryWithoutLimitOption
methods.description: Checks that building a query without limit results in no limit option.

methods.name: buildQueryWithLimitOption
methods.description: Verifies that building a query with limit options sets correct limit values.

methods.name: getAllOptionsReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that getAllOptions returns all configured options correctly.

methods.name: buildFullyFledgedSearchQuery
methods.description: Tests building a complete complex search query with filters, limit, and sorting.
